note: Scenario is per view; every view opens on 'asis'. Applied as a percentage-point offset to rate metrics (counts are unaffected); metrics flagged reverse:true (e.g. 'None met', 'Below Dakshata') take the opposite sign.

scenarios.label: Chain holding
scenarios.banner: Districts where the results chain holds: process implementation, teacher practice and learning move together in the same direction.

scenarios.label: Chain breaking
scenarios.banner: A struggling picture: processes are recorded as done, but teacher practice and student learning do not follow — the chain breaks between output and outcome.

divisionOffsets.note: Applied on top of the scenario delta when a single division is selected, so drill-down moves numbers plausibly and repeatably.
